title: Service Administrator
description: Service Administrator Location : Aldershot Salary: £26,000 - £32,000 P.A. DOE Hours: Mon-Fri, 7.30am - 5pm My client, a well-established independent vehicle service, MOT and repair centre based in Aldershot, are looking for a friendly and organised Service Administrator to join their team. This is a great opportunity for a customer-focused individual who enjoys a busy environment and is confident managing customers, bookings, and day-to-day administration. Role Summary The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the front-of-house reception, customer enquiries and bookings, whilst supporting the workshop and wider administration. Meet and greet customers and provide a friendly front-of-house service. Answer calls, respond to enquiries and follow up with customers. Book MOTs, servicing and repair work, ensuring all customer and vehicle details are accurate. Manage workshop bookings and capacity using the T-Card system. Complete job templates and bookings using Autowork. Order service parts and check oil requirements ahead of scheduled work. Use Autowork Online and Motasoft VGM to check customer records, MOT expiry dates, and outstanding work. Assist with vehicle drop-offs, collections, and loan vehicle administration. Produce invoices and process customer payments. Complete Payment Assist applications and liaise with customers and providers where required. Maintain accurate vehicle key records and ensure keys are stored correctly. Keep Work in Progress records up to date and liaise with technicians regarding parts, equipment, and delays. Manage customer parking and parts returns. Contact customers for additional work authorisation and keep them updated on timescales and parts availability. Support customer credit accounts, chase outstanding invoices and maintain accurate cash records. Process and scan invoices into Xero and ensure parts credits are correctly recorded. Skills and Experience Required Previous experience in service administration, vehicle reception, customer service, or a similar role is advantageous. Excellent customer service and communication skills. Highly organised with strong attention to detail. Confident managing multiple tasks in a busy environment. Professional and confident when dealing with customers face-to-face and over the telephone. Good IT and administration skills. Experience with Autowork, Motasoft VGM or Xero would be advantageous. Full UK driving licence valid for use in the UK and Ireland. If not an EU citizen, a valid UK working permit will be required. What We Offer No weekend or Bank Holiday working. 22 days paid holiday. Company pension scheme. Friendly and professional working environment. Opportunity to join a well-established and respected independent business.

title: Service Administrator
description: An opportunity to join a specialist engineering business, coordinating service visits, supporting engineers and keeping customer jobs on track. Are you an organised Service Administrator who enjoys keeping people, schedules and jobs running smoothly? We're looking for a Service Administrator to support a busy engineering service operation. You'll organise engineer schedules, liaise with customers, arrange travel and ensure the right information and documentation are in place for jobs to run efficiently. You don't necessarily need to have worked in exactly the same role before. Experience in service coordination, scheduling, technical administration or supporting a field-based team could all be relevant. The Role You'll play an important part in keeping engineering service activities organised, supporting field engineers and ensuring customers receive an efficient, professional service. - Coordinate and schedule service visits, allocating engineers according to availability, location and job requirements. - Manage changing schedules, rearrange appointments and resolve day-to-day issues. - Act as a key point of contact for customers, engineers, suppliers and internal teams. - Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, hotels and ferries. - Handle customer enquiries, process orders and clarify spare parts requirements. - Source technical manuals and ensure engineers have the information they need. - Maintain job files, service records, machine contract documentation and shared databases. - Review engineer expenses and overtime claims, obtain approvals and submit information for payroll. - Keep customers informed and ensure service activities are accurately documented. About You We're interested in people who enjoy organising, communicating and making sure nothing gets missed. You could have experience as a Service Administrator, Service Coordinator, Field Service Administrator, Scheduler, Engineering Administrator or in a similar coordination role. You'll ideally bring: - Experience coordinating schedules, appointments, jobs or field-based staff. - Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage changing priorities. - Confident communication skills when dealing with customers and colleagues. - A practical approach to resolving problems and keeping work moving. - Good attention to detail and confidence using Microsoft Office, Excel and business systems. Experience in engineering, manufacturing, industrial equipment, maintenance or another technical service environment would be advantageous. Experience arranging engineer travel, managing spare parts or maintaining service contracts would also be useful. Why Apply? - A varied role combining coordination, customer contact and service support. - The chance to take ownership of an important part of the operation. - Exposure to specialist engineering activities and international service arrangements. - An opportunity to develop your experience within a busy technical business. If you're an experienced Service Administrator or have transferable experience coordinating service work, managing schedules or supporting a busy operational team, we'd be keen to hear from you.
